cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(AVRBoardFixture LANGUAGES CXX)
include("${ROMODULAR_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/boards/AVR.cmake")
add_executable(AVRBoardFixture main.cpp)
target_compile_features(AVRBoardFixture PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
add_library(ImportedHeaders INTERFACE IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(ImportedHeaders PROPERTIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(AVRBoardFixture PRIVATE ImportedHeaders)
target_compile_definitions(AVRBoardFixture PRIVATE F_CPU=16000000UL)
romodular_configure_avr(AVRBoardFixture)
